verses.gurmukhi: ੧੧ : ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੇ ਫਸਦੇ ਤੇ ਕੁਫੱਕੜੀ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: 11 : moorakh aape fasadhe te kufa'kaRee han

en.bdb: Foolish gets himself entrapped and is a liar

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੋਤਾ ਨਲੀ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਆਪਣ ਹਥੀਂ ਫਾਥਾ ਚੀਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: totaa nalee na chhaddiee aapan hathee(n) faathaa cheekai|

en.bdb: The parrot does not leave the rod and caught in it cries and wails.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਂਦਰੁ ਮੁਠਿ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਚੈ ਝੀਕਣੁ ਝੀਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: baa(n)dhar muTh na chhaddiee ghar ghar nachai jheekan jheekai|

en.bdb: Monkey too does not leave the handful of corn (in the pitcher) and suffers dancing and gritting its teeth from door to door.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਦਹੁ ਅੜੀ ਨ ਛਡਈ ਚੀਘੀ ਪਉਦੀ ਹੀਕਣਿ ਹੀਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: gadhahu aRee na chhaddiee cheeghee paudhee heekan heekai|

en.bdb: The donkey also when beaten, kicks and brays loudly but does not shed its stubbornness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤੇ ਚਕੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਸਿਧੀ ਧ੍ਰੀਕਣਿ ਧ੍ਰੀਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: kute chakee chaTanee poochh na sidhee dhreekan dhreekai|

en.bdb: The dog does not leave licking the flour mill and its tail though pulled, never turns straight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨਿ ਕੁਫਕੜ ਮੂਰਖਾਂ ਸਪ ਗਏ ਫੜਿ ਫਾਟਨਿ ਲੀਕੈ।
verses.translit_en: karan kufakaR moorakhaa(n) sap ge faR faaTan leekai|

en.bdb: The foolish ones boast foolishly and beat the track while the snake has gone away.
Even when humiliated by their turbans taken off their heads, they count themselves superior to their collaterals.
